voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: The Atlantic, eighteen seventy-two. The men who boarded the empty Mary Celeste found a sounding rod on her deck.
A tool for measuring water in the hold. Beside it, one of her pumps had been partly taken apart.
Two hatches stood open. Below, about three and a half feet of water. Not enough to sink her.
One theory: a false reading convinced the captain she was sinking, and they left in the only boat.
She stayed afloat and was brought into Gibraltar. Not one of the ten who sailed on her was ever seen again.
